Title: Chen Patch
Subtitle: Technical Alpha patch 0.5.0.32120 (September 10, 2014, article 15787795) adding playable Hero Chen, Legendary Brewmaster, to the Nexus.
Affected: Zagara's prices have been reduced to 7
Highlights: Technical Alpha patch 0.5.0.32120 (September 10, 2014, article 15787795) adding playable Hero Chen, Legendary Brewmaster, to the Nexus.
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Chen, Legendary Brewmaster:
  • - Trait — Fortifying Brew (D): Powers Abilities with Brew instead of Mana and grants a Shield while drinking.
  • - Flying Kick (Q): Kicks through a target enemy.
  • - Keg Smash (W): Drenches enemies in a nearby area with Brew, slowing them.
  • - Breath of Fire (E): Breathes fire in a target direction, dealing damage and igniting Brew-soaked enemies.
  • - Wandering Keg (R): Jumps into a barrel to knock enemies around and deal damage.
  • - Storm, Earth, Fire (R): Splits into three spirits with new Abilities.
